## Problem
What are you trying to do that the Actor doesn't currently support? Is this related to a limitation you've run into?

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature or change you'd like. Be as specific as possible — e.g. a new input field, a new output field, support for search/listing pages instead of single items, etc.

## Example
If relevant, show what the input or output would look like with this feature.

```json
{
  "example": "input or output here"
}
```

## Alternatives considered
Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've tried or thought about.

## Additional context
Anything else that helps explain the request (links, screenshots, related issues).
